title: Three family branches
hook: A family tree compares shared ancestry.

knows: Animals have structures and behaviors that can be investigated.
doesNotKnow: The highlighted branching point joins crocodilians with birds before their branch meets the lizard branch. This simplified tree shows relative common ancestry, not a claim that a living crocodilian is the direct ancestor of birds.

misconception: The evidence in the scenario supports a different interpretation.
objective: Which pair shares a more recent common ancestor: crocodilians, birds or lizards?

claims.text: A family tree compares shared ancestry. Which pair shares a more recent common ancestor: crocodilians, birds or lizards? The highlighted branching point joins crocodilians with birds before their branch meets the lizard branch. This simplified tree shows relative common ancestry, not a claim that a living crocodilian is the direct ancestor of birds.

claims.text: The phylogeny is a simplified cladogram, not a dated tree or depiction of every living lineage.
Does the tree say that a living crocodilian is the direct ancestor of a living bird? The tree shows a shared ancestor, not that one living branch is the direct ancestor of the other.
